newsitem.title: USA: Boeing Business Jets gets order.
newsitem.headline: Boeing Business Jets gets order.

text.p: Boeing Business Jets said Monday it had signed its first definitive contract for a business jet airplane order outside of the joint venture.
Boeing Business Jets was formed this summer by Boeing Co and General Electric Co.
The order was made by Aviation Methods Inc, on behalf of an annonymous customer for one business for delievery in late 1998.
GE launched the business jet program in July with orders for two airplanes, the first of which will be delivered in the fourth quarter of 1998.

Boeing Business Jets said it anticipates additional contracts in the near future. The company was formed in July to meet market demand for a larger, more versatile business airplane that can fly more than 6,000 nautical miles.
The business jet is a derivative of the next-generation 737 and will be able to serve such routes as New York to Tokyo and London to Johannesburg.
